name: autorejoin
author: yunyun
short: Keeps the bot locked to a configured voice channel — rejoins automatically if disconnected.
description: Per-guild auto-rejoin system. Set a target voice channel, then enable the feature. The bot will join immediately and rejoin automatically whenever it is kicked, disconnected, or moved away. Disabled by default; each guild controls its own toggle independently. Includes an instant event-driven rejoin on disconnect plus a periodic watchdog loop as a safety net.
install_msg: Loaded! Admin: set the target channel with `autorejoin setup #voice-channel`, then run `autorejoin enable`. Use `autorejoin status` to check the current state.
